summary.value: New York Marriott Marquis, a Marriott hotel on Times Square, puts guests in the middle of the action, and reviews consistently praise its location, clean rooms and good-value breakfast. The trade-offs are nighttime street noise and an added daily fee.

description.value: New York Marriott Marquis is the giant Marriott hotel on Times Square, with the Marquis Theatre built into the property and Broadway on every side. Trip.com guests rate it 8.9 / 10 Very good 655 reviews and say The hotel has a fantastic location and the rooms are very clean. Breakfast is called a bargain add-on, and the cheesecake and avocado salad get recommended. Honest watch-outs: it can get a bit noisy at night, and the hotel charges a mandatory $40 daily fee.

itineraryNote: New York Marriott Marquis: a Marriott hotel on Times Square with clean rooms; try the cheesecake, then walk straight out to Broadway shows.
review1: The Marriott Marquis earns consistent praise for its Times Square location and clean rooms, which guests see as the core reasons to book it.
review2: Breakfast is considered good value for a modest add-on price, and guests recommend it as an easy start before a full day of sightseeing.
review3: Food recommendations recur, with guests singling out the cheesecake and the avocado salad as dishes worth ordering during a stay.
review4: The trade-off for being in the middle of Times Square is street noise at night, so light sleepers should request a room on a higher floor.
